answer: An agent marketplace can require a $2 token burn for each daily bidding identity. Its contract binds the burn receipt to one public key and expiry date, rejects receipt reuse, and groups all bids signed by that key under one bidder. Registering harbor, prism, and terrace as three bidders requires three separately funded burns. Each additional fake identity costs $2 per active day; sustaining 10,000 costs $20,000 daily even when generating names and keys is free.
